primary_source.title: Designing more efficient quantum circuits with Claude
primary_source.fact: Published Oct16 17:29Z, modified Oct17 14:17Z. Anthropic says Claude Mythos 5 used a closed loop: propose circuits, receive evaluator feedback, iterate without human input. Eight computational primitives span chemistry, optimization, quantum simulation, number theory and numerical computing. Linked arXiv 2610.22367 (submitted Oct15; Andi Gu, Alek H. Kemeny, Susanne F. Yelin, Mikhail D. Lukin) says seven of eight tasks reduced Toffoli and qubit counts versus prior state of art; the eighth created a reversible prime-field modular-inversion architecture. Research finding, not a model release or Arena score.

tencent_lead.facts: Tech Times (published Oct19 17:04Z) says Tencent released Hy-Memory-30B-A3B on Oct15: a 30B memory-writing MoE. It reports 55.49 vs Claude Opus 5 54.62 on four Tencent-designed/run memory benchmarks, explicitly not independently replicated. Linked arXiv 2610.22196 (submitted Oct15), “Hy-Memory-30B-A3B: Attributed Reinforcement Learning for Long-Term Memory Writing,” authors Tianxiang Fei, Jiazheng Kang, Mao Zheng, Xingyan He, Xiang Yu. Memory benchmarks, not Text Arena.
